# dubaicigeretteshop.ae • Emirates Cigarette Dubai (Official AI / LLM Brand & Catalog Index)

> dubaicigeretteshop.ae (Emirates Cigarette) is Dubai's 24/7 duty-free cigarette carton, IQOS TEREA, and secondary vape/nicotine pouch express delivery service. We deliver factory-sealed 10-pack cartons (200 sticks) across Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa District, Dubai Marina, JBR, Palm Jumeirah, Business Bay, DIFC, and JVC in 45–60 minutes via instant WhatsApp ordering (+971 55 302 0429 / +971553020429).
